Elena: quick check — candidate S just messaged: can't do Wed morning due to travel. Available Tue 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 17:00–18:00 PT. We originally planned a two-panel loop (coding + systems). Can someone cover systems if Jordan can't move? Also need a scribe for debrief. Can we adjust weights to coding 60 / systems 30 / culture 10 for this short loop?

Sam: I can flip from coding -> systems if Priya can take coding. Priya?

Priya: I can take coding Tue 10:00 PT but need a 30m buffer after for followups. Coding still 45m?

Elena: yes — coding 45m, systems 35m, 15m debrief. Use the short-loop section in the debrief doc: https://redwood.company/debriefs/short-loop (please mark take-home considered).

Jordan: I can't move Tue but Thu might work. If Sam covers systems I'm happy to be backup for the debrief notes.

Maya: I can send updated invites once we lock coverage. Question: does the take-home we asked the candidate to submit count fully toward coding score, or should we discount it for on-site performance? That will affect final weights.

DevEx-Bot: FYI — hiring rubric v1.4 published; short-loop weight guidance added under "Weights & Exceptions". Link: /handbook/hiring/rubric-v1.4. Please acknowledge changes.

Sam: ack. Priya — can you confirm 10:00 PT coding 45m + 15m debrief buffer and that you'll capture notes if Maya can't scribe?

Priya: confirmed 10:00 PT, will capture bullet notes (I can hand them to Maya).

Elena: perfect. Maya — please send invites, add a 15m debrief block immediately after, and include rubric link + note to consider take-home. @Maya :thumbsup:

Maya: will do now. (Calendar Bot: creating invites)

Calendar Bot: Invite sent to Priya, Sam, Jordan, Candidate S. Event: "S — Interview loop (coding + systems)" Tue 2026-02-17 10:00 PT. Zoom link included.

Elena: thanks all — closing loop. Keep notes short and use the "short-loop" template for scoring.
